name: Quorum
definition: Specifies whether a quorum is required or not together with the quorum parameters.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Minimum quantity of securities required to hold a meeting.

Percentage.name: Percentage
Percentage.definition: Minimum quantity of securities, expressed as a percentage, required to hold a meeting.

QuorumRequired.name: Quorum Required
QuorumRequired.definition: Specifies whether a minimum number of security representation is required to hold a meeting.

Meeting.name: Meeting
Meeting.definition: Meeting for which a quorum is specified.
